lines.1: 「I think I'll be home late today, since I have to help the executive committee too.」
lines.3: 「You're pretty busy even though it's summer break, with your club and the student council.」
lines.5: 「No. The Princess, Sato, and I will be enough.」
lines.7: 「You're going on a date with Konoe today?」
lines.9: 「Make sure you look presentable. And behave like a gentleman.」
lines.10: ...That was the conversation we'd had that morning.
